notes: UCR result is only an aggregate statement (~78% of 128 datasets within 2 pp of or better than best ED/DTW benchmark); per-dataset accuracies are only in Figs. 4-6 (not extractable as text). Train/test split for UCR is not described (presumably official UCR splits, not stated). Forecast setup text says N=5 but Table 1 reports N-gram 3/5/7; quantisation Q for forecasting is not stated; training epochs for forecasting not stated; error metric only loosely defined (upper bound sqrt(48)/24 suggests an RMS-type error over 24 steps). Figure captions disagree with Table 1 (ARMA .9/-.1 in Fig. 12 vs 0.7/-0.1 in Table 1; SAR seasonal coefficient .4 in Fig. 13b not in Table 1). Forecast usages are recorded as regression/forecasting; task_detail also carries the generation keys because the forecasts are recursive autoregressive sequence generation. The 'max 32 bits for each automata' in Sec. 5.1 is a hypothetical memory estimate, not a reported state width.
